name: Verify Pending Identity Email
summary: The user submits a valid NuvIoT email-verification code; ownership becomes verified for identity resolution while the PendingIdentity still cannot exercise normal application authorization.

preconditions.expression: the OAuth-external PendingIdentity verification operation is active and the supplied NuvIoT code is valid

serverInteraction.intent: Consume the NuvIoT verification code, record verified email ownership on the PendingIdentity, and advance to identity resolution without yet granting normal application authorization.

postconditions.expression: email ownership is independently verified, the PendingIdentity is ready for resolution, and no durable application session exists

sourceReferences.note: Approved authentication policy requires independent NuvIoT email proof before an unlinked external provider may be linked to an existing durable identity; provider email is supporting evidence only.
